title: UI: Eraser tool on stage canvas
description: Implement the eraser tool in the authoring UI. When eraser is active and user drags over the stage, erase portions of ShapeDisplayObjects (or full objects). Simple approach: if eraser circle overlaps a shape's bounding box, remove that object from the frame. Advanced: path-based clipping. Start with bounding-box removal. Wire up in Shell.tsx and StageArea.tsx.
